title: His children and granddaughter
summary: His son and daughter's careers and his granddaughter who plays vibes and studied music business.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: Your kids – how many children do you have?

My son was for a while. He was in the first graduating class from LaGuardia Performing Arts. He played saxophone. But he’s not playing now. He’s the manager at Bergdorf Goodman’s Men’s Store. He’s been into retail for a while.
So he’s not struggling. He’s not a starving musician.
He probably learned quick. “Dad, this is great, but I got to live.”

My daughter, she works for the Brooklyn district attorney. My granddaughter, however, plays vibes. She went to Berklee up in Boston. Her major was music business, but she played vibes up there. She wants to get back into it now. So we’ll see what happens.
